summary: Master UAS for disaster response. Learn Pix4D mapping, thermal SAR, and BVLOS operations to accelerate recovery. Enroll in our 5-day expert-led course.
lede: Drone operations in disaster response and recovery help emergency and geospatial professionals plan missions and use aerial data for assessment. The training covers UAS risk and airspace planning, sensor selection, thermal search, photogrammetry, damage mapping, and GIS integration. It is designed for professionals deploying aerial assets for search and rescue, infrastructure inspection, and recovery monitoring.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who are responsible for the strategic and tactical deployment of aerial assets in high-pressure environments.
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of UAS flight operations and hold a valid local pilot certification where applicable. Familiarity with Geographic Information Systems (GIS) concepts and emergency management terminology is recommended. You will need a laptop capable of running photogrammetry software for the data processing modules.
